bundle.shortDescription: See how a LivePremier allocates its VPU mixers
bundle.longDescription: Reads an Analog Way LivePremier's VPU mixer allocation over AWJ and draws it — what each screen is spending, what is left, and what a pending configuration would change. Reads only; it never writes to the switcher.
